name: Agent Discovery and Invocation
description: Triggered via a webhook (POST), this workflow lists all SAP agents available for the tenant, then invokes the Billing Posting Agent using the SAP Agent Node, and returns the full agent list plus the agent response to the caller.

parameters.content:
## Available Agents Configuration
This configuration is hardcoded — AVAILABLE_AGENTS reflects the tenant agent registry at workflow creation time (80+ agents across Billing, HR, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, CX, and more).
Update this list if agents are added or removed from the tenant.
